reviewItem.question: For "Content-Type Auto-Detection: In v3, the `Content-Type` header is not auto-detected anymore when it is not set by the backend", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the environment relies on automatic Content-Type header detection from backend responses that lack explicit Content-Type

proposed.statement: In Traefik 3.0, automatic Content-Type header detection is removed when the backend does not set the Content-Type header; the ContentType middleware must be explicitly used to enable this detection.
